Quotes that open with a quotation mark:

> “Good design is as little design as possible.” The rest of this sentence wraps onto a second line so the first letters can be compared.
>
> A plain second paragraph with no opening mark.

> “A one-paragraph quote that opens with a mark, long enough to wrap onto a second line in the column.”

> A quote with no opening mark stays where it is.
